name: Prisma
covers: Rerail's own Prisma rules, from the Prisma docs and maintainers' advice, for safe transactions, bulk writes and raw SQL, one client, and rows that do not leak to the browser.

rules.title: Prisma practice: inside an interactive $transaction callback, query through tx and pass tx to helpers, never the outer client
Prisma practice: await every tx query inside the $transaction callback; never leave one floating or start it from forEach(async …) or a timer
Prisma practice: pass values to $queryRawUnsafe, $executeRawUnsafe and Prisma.raw as query parameters, never pasted into the SQL text
Prisma practice: give every deleteMany and updateMany a where that is always set
Prisma practice: never pass a request body or a Server Action's argument to Prisma as `data`; parse it with a schema or pick the fields
Prisma practice: never send a row with a password hash, token or secret column to the browser; select the columns it needs or omit the secret ones
Prisma practice: send mail, charge payments, call HTTP APIs, enqueue jobs and revalidate caches after an interactive transaction returns, not inside it
Prisma practice: apply migrations on deploy with prisma migrate deploy, never migrate dev, migrate reset or a data-losing db push
Prisma practice: change counters, stock and balances with increment/decrement or a guarded update, not by writing back arithmetic on a value read earlier
Prisma practice: create PrismaClient once per process, never per call in a handler, and cache it on globalThis in a Next.js app
Prisma practice: load or write a list's rows in one query (an `in` filter, include, createMany, updateMany or a $transaction batch), not one query per item
